premise: Raccoon finds the moon in the pond and dips their paws in to feel it; the ripples break it into pieces; Frog and Snail try to hold it still, and only when everyone stops touching does the moon come back whole.
inspiration: The Moon in the Well (folk tale of villagers who try to fish the moon out), turned: curious friends, not fools, and the joke is one they all share.
lesson: Some things mend themselves if you stop and let them.
learning: Raccoons dip what they find in water and feel it with their paws.

en-US.title: Raccoon Washes the Moon
en-US.text: {sfx:night} [softly] It was a still, silver night. Raccoon {raccoon:pulse} came down to the pond, and stopped. [gasps] There, in the water, was the moon. Round and white and close. So Raccoon did what Raccoon does with every new thing: dipped it in the water to feel it with their paws. {sfx:dip solo} Swish, swish. The moon wobbled. {raccoon:wobble} It broke into a hundred silver pieces! [surprised] Frog {frog:hop} hopped over, and Snail {snail:pulse} came too, slowly. I was only feeling it, said Raccoon. Frog tried to hold it still with her feet. Wobble! Snail tried with his shell. Wobble! [curious] Let us all stop touching, said Snail. So they sat and watched. The ripples went out… and out… and away. And the moon came back together, {raccoon:glow #DDE8FF} whole and round and perfect. [whispers] It just needed a rest, said Raccoon. Like us. And the three of them yawned at the moon.

es-ES.title: Mapache lava la luna
es-ES.text: {sfx:night} [softly] Era una noche quieta y plateada. Mapache {raccoon:pulse} bajó al estanque, y se paró. [gasps] Allí, en el agua, estaba la luna. Redonda y blanca y tan cerca que casi se tocaba. Y Mapache hizo lo que hace con todas las cosas nuevas: la metió en el agua para tocarla con las patas. {sfx:dip solo} Chas, chas. La luna tembló. {raccoon:wobble} ¡Se rompió en cien trocitos de plata! [surprised] Rana {frog:hop} llegó de un salto, y Caracol {snail:pulse} también, despacio. Solo la estaba tocando, dijo Mapache. Rana intentó sujetarla con las patas. ¡Tiembla! Caracol lo intentó con su concha. ¡Tiembla! [curious] Dejemos todos de tocar, dijo Caracol. Y se sentaron, y esperaron, y miraron. Las ondas se fueron… y se fueron… y se fueron. Y la luna volvió a juntarse, {raccoon:glow #DDE8FF} entera, redonda y perfecta. [whispers] Solo necesitaba descansar, dijo Mapache. Como nosotros. Y los tres le bostezaron a la luna.

night.prompt: a calm pond at night, soft crickets and the faintest lap of still water

dip.prompt: small paws dabbling and swishing in shallow pond water, gentle splashy stirring
